U.note: Clear pelican with pouch bill and helmet on a bike with many controls, but the body floats above the frame and the legs look disconnected.

V.note: Clean, readable pelican with chain and bell, but a sparse scene and slightly awkward leg and foot placement.

W.note: Charming helmeted pelican with trees and hills and a wing reaching the bars; controls are minimal and the ring-bell checkbox is a little odd.

X.note: Largest, most detailed pelican with wing on handlebars, chain, bell and a responsive layout; the most convincing rider.

Y.note: Polished scene with a believable pedaling pose, honk bubble and a live status readout; the controls are well integrated.

Z.note: Pleasant scene, but the wing is a flat grey slab, the legs are awkward and the status label is vague.
